title: Travis Kelce's Ex-Girlfriend Maya Benberry Warns Taylor Swift Amid New Romance Rumors
htmlContent:
The world of professional sports and entertainment is often a hotbed of headlines and relationship rumors. Recently, Travis Kelce, the Kansas City Chiefs' star tight end, made headlines with his rumored romance with superstar singer Taylor Swift. However, amidst the buzz surrounding this new relationship, Kelce's ex-girlfriend, Maya Benberry, has issued a stark warning to Swift, based on her past experiences with the NFL player.

Maya Benberry, a reality TV star known for her appearance on the E! dating reality series "Catching Kelce" in 2016, dated Travis Kelce for several months following her win on the show. However, their relationship was short-lived, and the couple eventually parted ways. It was during this time that Benberry publicly accused the Super Bowl champion of infidelity, particularly in relation to his subsequent relationship with sports broadcaster Kayla Nicole. In a series of now-deleted tweets, Benberry alleged that Kelce had cheated on her.

In an exclusive interview with DailyMail.com, Maya Benberry offered a candid perspective on Travis Kelce's rumored connection with Taylor Swift. While acknowledging Swift's fun-loving spirit and beautiful personality, Benberry issued a stark caution, saying, "Once a cheater, always a cheater." She emphasized the importance of Swift being cautious in her new relationship, adding, "I'm sure by now she has mastered the ability to see who is really there for her - and who is just using her."

Maya Benberry, who also works as a life coach, shared her advice based on her past experiences with Kelce. She expressed hope that Swift would come out of the situation as the teacher rather than the student, underlining the significance of being discerning in matters of the heart.

It's worth noting that Travis Kelce has never publicly commented on the allegations made by Maya Benberry during their previous relationship. Despite the accusations, Kelce's subsequent relationships, including his on-and-off dating history with Kayla Nicole from 2017 to 2022, continued without public acknowledgment of the past.

Speculation about Travis Kelce's romantic involvement with Taylor Swift initially sparked when Kelce revealed on his podcast, "New Heights," that he had tried to get Swift's attention at one of her concerts by offering her a friendship bracelet with his phone number. Although Swift had already left the stadium, she became aware of the gesture after it gained public attention.

As rumors swirled, Kelce's brother, Jason Kelce, who plays for the Philadelphia Eagles, added fuel to the fire during an interview, stating, "I think they're doing great, and I think it's all 100 percent true." However, Travis Kelce himself remained relatively tight-lipped about the romantic rumors.

As the rumors continued, Taylor Swift was spotted in the stands, enthusiastically cheering on Travis Kelce during a Kansas City Chiefs game against the Chicago Bears. Swift and Kelce's mother, Donna, enjoyed a special VIP section and appeared to have a great time supporting the Super Bowl champions.

Should Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's rumored relationship continue to develop, it would likely involve navigating the challenges of a long-distance relationship. Swift's busy tour schedule has her traveling internationally through August 2024, while Kelce's NFL commitments extend into early January, with the potential for a Super Bowl run in February.

The world of celebrity relationships often captures the public's attention, and the rumored romance between Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce is no exception. While Maya Benberry's cautionary words may reflect her own experiences, it remains to be seen how the relationship between Swift and Kelce will unfold. As the two navigate the complexities of their personal lives, they will undoubtedly continue to be in the spotlight, subject to both scrutiny and support from fans and onlookers alike.
